prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A visually striking, top-down composition featuring a single white, ridged paper plate centered on a deep red rectangular tray. On the plate, a golden-brown pretzel is artfully shaped into a stylized hexagonal logo with a prominent "C" in the middle, resembling the Civitai brand mark. The plate is printed with bold, black uppercase text at the top reading "CIVITAI" and a tagline at the bottom, "Feed Your Imagination," in a clean, modern font. The background is a solid, matte red, matching the tray and creating a harmonious, monochromatic color palette with warm, inviting tones. The lighting is soft and even, minimizing shadows and emphasizing the textures of the pretzel and the paper plate. The overall style is minimalistic and graphic, with a playful, contemporary feel, reminiscent of high-end commercial food photography or branding visuals. The image is sharply focused, with a shallow depth of field that keeps all elements crisp and clear, drawing attention to the central logo-pretzel and the clever integration of branding and food.
